transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

Mostly… people keep telling me I’m not listening. Like my supervisor or my wife will be talking right to me, and then a minute later I realize I only got maybe half of what they said. Then I have to ask them to repeat it. It’s been causing problems.
Do you find it hard to focus on tasks or conversations, even when there’s no obvious distraction around you?

Yeah… I guess so. Even if it’s quiet, someone can be talking right to me and I’ll realize I only caught part of it. Then I have to ask them to repeat themselves. It’s been… happening enough that people notice.
Do you often find yourself missing details or making mistakes because you’re not paying close attention, even when you’re trying to focus?

Yeah… at work mostly. On the line I’ll kind of rush through the checks, and then I miss small stuff—like a wrong label or something not tightened right. My supervisor’s had to pull me aside about it more than once.
